title: FreeLimitedEndpoint
description: A free/limited LLM endpoint registry row. The endpoint declares signals (official docs present? shared-key markers? browser runtime? etc.); the intelligence engine classifies it (numeric class_code in free_endpoint_class_codes.json) and runs due diligence. Rate-limit/free-tier figures are owner_provided_unverified until confirmed against official docs. Raw keys are NEVER stored — secret_ref only.

signals.description: {has_official_docs, shared_key_markers, reverse_engineered_markers, browser_runtime, rate_limit_documented, data_retention_documented, paid_required?}

rate_limit_claim.description: {summary, source, confidence} — confidence must be 'unverified' for third-party claims

secret_ref.description: secret://... reference; NEVER a raw key
